title: SM ST7C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST7C 静态励磁系统，带有自动电压调节器，输入 9 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_G (s)} 指定电压滤波的时间常数、{Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_F (s)} 指定电压调节器的滞后时间常数、{Maximum voltage reference, V_max (pu)} 指定最大电压参考值、{Minimum voltage reference, V_min (pu)} 指定最小电压参考值、{Voltage regulator gain, K_PA (pu)} 指定电压调节器增益、{Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} 指定电压调节器滞后时间常数、{Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} 指定电压调节器超前时间常数、{Thyristor bridge firing control equivalent time constant, T_A (s)} 指定第一个超前-滞后环节的调节器滞后时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器最大输出、{Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器最小输出、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Minimum excitation limit gain, K_L (pu)} 指定最小励磁限制增益、{Maximum excitation limit gain, K_H (pu)} 指定最大励磁限制增益、{PI regulator feedback gain, K_IA (pu)} 指定 PI 调节器反馈增益、{PI regulator feedback time constant, T_IA (s)} 指定 PI 调节器反馈时间常数，按实例取值。
